name: E2E SiteMinder - Reservation triggers (sample messages, self-provoked)
description: Posts SiteMinder's documented sample reservation messages to the connector's own reservation endpoint and checks the four reservation triggers and the OTA answers. Needs no SiteMinder account and proves nothing about SiteMinder itself: it tests this side of the exchange with sample payloads.

fca872f8-88d4-4baf-a968-13f509a6c6d4.content:
## Self-provoked: sample messages, no SiteMinder account

The `Post` components send SiteMinder's documented sample messages (minimum content, maximum content, minimum cancellation) to this instance's own reservation endpoint, `/plugins/appmixer/siteminder/reservations`. The URL is built from `g_webhookUrl`, so the flow works on any instance.

**Account:** the four triggers need a SiteMinder connection with **Endpoint Username** `appmixer-e2e-sample` and **Endpoint Password** `E2e-Sample-0nly!2026` (API Token empty). The messages carry exactly these credentials; with any other account every Post is answered with error 497 and the flow fails. These credentials are public sample values: never use them for a connection that receives real reservations.

The last two Posts check the refusals: a wrong password (OTA error 497) and a hotel no flow listens for (OTA error 392). Both are answered with HTTP 200, as SiteMinder requires.
